info.title: DigitoFina API

post.description: Public incoming webhook endpoint for mobile money providers, SMS providers, bank payment providers, and external partner systems. Stores raw payload and headers, verifies signatures for configured providers, detects duplicates, and queues processing.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider code such as mtn-webhooks, airtel-money, twilio, or partner-api.

parameters.name: X-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC signature when the provider is configured to require signatures. Header name is provider configurable.

parameters.name: X-Event-Id
parameters.description: Provider event id used for duplicate detection when supplied.

200.description: Duplicate webhook received and not reprocessed.

post.description: Queues a failed webhook event for another processing attempt. Requires Sanctum token and manage-settings or manage-accounting permission.

x-error-response-example.message: Only failed webhook events can be retried.

Unauthenticated.description: Missing, expired, or revoked Sanctum token.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated user does not have the required permission or branch/organization access.

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found or is outside the authenticated tenant scope.

IdempotencyConflict.description: Idempotency key is already processing or was reused with a different request body.

value.message: Idempotency key is already processing or request hash does not match the original request.
